brief.description: Cold and warm starts compared within the returned selected window; this is observed cohort evidence, not a causal test.

comparison.help: A drive is a cold start when the car sat parked for 6+ hours first, and a warm start when the gap is 1 hour or less; in-between gaps are excluded as ambiguous. The comparison uses distance-weighted whole-drive consumption, not just the first kilometres. It does not adjust for temperature, route, speed or trip length, so the observed difference does not isolate battery or cabin warm-up.
comparison.noGroups: This window has no drives in the warm or cold parking-gap groups.
comparison.noPositivePenalty: The cold cohort did not consume more than the distance-weighted warm cohort in this selected observed window. No positive whole-drive difference or savings is claimed.

coldStart.takeaway: Applying the observed whole-drive cold-minus-warm consumption difference to the cold cohort distance gives {{energy}}. This is not measured warm-up energy or guaranteed savings. If plugged in before departure, preconditioning may shift some warm-up energy to the wall; this comparison does not estimate that benefit.
coldStart.takeawayCost: Applying the observed whole-drive cold-minus-warm consumption difference to the cold cohort distance gives {{energy}} — about {{cost}} at your electricity rate. This is not measured warm-up energy or guaranteed savings. If plugged in before departure, preconditioning may shift some warm-up energy to the wall; this comparison does not estimate that benefit.
